items.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023
items.q: A good friend of mine took a photo... Because that guy meant a lot to me.

ctx.x: that made a couple of these for me. And I’m so happy to wear it you know. Because that guy meant a lot to me.

Mike Longo, who I got to interview, said something that I took note of. He said, “In our music, rhythm and melody are almost the same. Dizzy used to use the term ‘melodization of rhythm.’” And I think what he meant by that is Dizzy was hearing rhythms and putting pitches to it.

He also said, “Improvising is like painting on the canvas” you know. You mix the color, you create shades and this and that. It’s like you’re creating — you have to imagine the whole picture in your mind when you are improvising. It’s like creating a speech for something. A good speech in America they start, “Good evening ladies and gentlemen, here we are” la-la-la-la. But we have some issue that we have to talk about and then they start changing the tone, the volume, [inaudible] at the end they wrap. And they…
